jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

As a General Manager, you’ll join as a first leadership hire in the region to scale our India delivery hub: building a high-calibre team, setting the cultural standard, and creating an industry-leading project delivery capability.

You'll work closely with our business leadership, GTM, Product and Tech teams globally, with the long-term goal of scaling the India org to several hundred people. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on variety and ambiguity, understands what it takes to build a world-class operation in a new hub and cares deeply about the talent bar and the company’s image.

 

What you'll do

 - Build the organisation. You'll shape how the team is structured, and set the standard for everything that follows — with the goal of growing to several hundred people over time.

 - Turn strategy into execution. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with leadership to break down company priorities into concrete plans, clear ownership, and the operational discipline needed to actually deliver them across the India function.

 - Create the operating backbone. Establish the rhythms and routines — planning cycles, performance cadences, leadership check-ins — that keep a fast-scaling team focused, aligned, and moving without losing momentum.

 - Fix what's slowing us down. Proactively identify where the organisation is getting stuck — whether that's process gaps, capacity constraints, or structural friction — and build solutions that scale as we grow.

 - Maintain an exceptionally high bar for talent. Every hire matters. You'll set the hiring standard, make the tough calls, and ensure the people joining the India team are genuinely exceptional.

 - Make Encord a destination in India. Build a brand that the best people in the market actually want to join. The product you're selling is the opportunity itself; make it real.

 - Build a culture worth staying for. Create an environment where people do the best work of their careers — one that reflects Encord's values and holds up as the team scales, not just when it's small.
   
    

Who we're looking for

 - You operate like an owner. You don't wait for direction — you identify what needs to happen, build the plan, and execute it. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down; it's where you do your best work.

 - You move people without authority. You get things done across teams and geographies through trust, clear framing, and good judgement — not by leaning on your title or escalating up the chain.

 - You hold the line on quality. Whether it's a hire, a process, or a client deliverable, you have high standards and the conviction to enforce them even when it's inconvenient.

 - You build for the long term. You're not here to hit a short-term target and move on — you want to build something that lasts, and you understand that culture and talent bar are the foundations everything else rests on.
   
    

Experience requirements

 - 10–15 years of general management or site leadership experience, ideally with a strong consulting foundation — ex-MBB at Project Leader, Engagement Manager, or Principal level is the benchmark

 - Proven experience building teams in a high-growth or operationally complex environment

 - Deep understanding of the local talent market and the ability to build a brand that competes

 - A global mindset — you understand the business standards and can bring that rigour and culture to your team

 - Exceptional people instincts: you know how to recruit for excellence and how to protect culture as a team scales

 - Comfortable with ambiguity — we don't have all the answers yet, and you'll help shape them
   
    

Why Encord

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth, Series C start-up

 - Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly — this role grows with the business

 - Flexible PTO and generous paid vacation days

 - Annual learning & development budget to invest in your growth

 - Comprehensive health coverage

 - Regular travel opportunities to our London HQ and global team events

 - Bi-annual company offsites, twice-weekly team lunches, and monthly socials

jobs.title: Sales Director
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're looking for a founding Sales Director to lead revenue growth across our markets. This is a rare opportunity to join a hyper-growth AI infrastructure company in a true leadership seat — reporting directly to the VP of Global Sales and working alongside the co-founders. You'll come in as a leader, inherit and grow a team, and shape how we go to market as we scale.



What you'll do

 - Lead and grow a high-performing sales team — hiring, coaching, and developing Encord sellers while staying close to the market yourself

 - Own revenue growth across your market — taking the product to leading AI and tech businesses and scaling to $millions in ARR

 - Navigate complex, full-cycle enterprise and mid-market sales with customers ranging from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500s

 - Partner with the VP of Global Sales on GTM strategy, ICP expansion, and new verticals — with a clear path to owning an expanded geography, sector, or team as we scale

 - Roll up your sleeves and run sales cycles yourself during the ramp period — learning the product, the buyers, and the motion firsthand so you can coach your team from experience, not theory

 - Become the authoritative voice on how Encord is positioned and pitched — setting the standard for the team around you

 - Represent Encord externally — at industry events, in senior customer relationships, and across the broader AI and Physical AI ecosystem

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to shape the roadmap and inform go-to-market decisions

 - Step up wherever needed: marketing, events, community, onboarding — this is a founding leadership role



Who we're looking for

 - A proven sales leader with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams — and the commercial credibility to lead from the front

 - Someone who thrives in ambiguity — you don't wait for a playbook, you write it

 - Deep experience selling technical products to technical buyers — ML engineers, data scientists, CTOs, and AI platform leads

 - A builder mentality — you want to leave something behind, not just hit a number

 - High commercial IQ — able to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals while keeping momentum and coaching others to do the same

 - Genuine excitement about Physical AI and where the market is going
   
    

Experience requirements

 - 7–12 years in GTM roles at B2B SaaS companies, with a proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing sales teams

 - Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain top sales talent — you've built teams, not just joined them

 - Strong commercial intuition with the ability to build rapport and influence at all levels — from junior operators to CTOs

 - The gravitas to engage and win over senior leadership, and the ability to instil that same credibility in the people around you

 - Track record of top-percentile performance in sales leadership, academia, sport, or any competitive environment you've entered

 - A clear point of view on what great GTM looks like — and the conviction to build it from scratch in a fast-moving environment
   
    

Why Encord

 - Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth start-up

 - Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

 - Strong in-person culture: 4 days/week

 - Flexible PTO to fully recharge

 - Annual learning & development budget

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

 - Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

 - Bi-annual company offsites, twice-weekly team lunches, and monthly socials

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 


THE ROLE

As Finance Associate at Encord, you'll own the operational core of our finance function, including: supplier payments, customer invoicing, and month-end reconciliations - ensuring everything runs accurately and on time. You'll partner closely with the wider finance function and cross-functional teams across the business, helping make finance a great partner to the rest of the company. The day-to-day processes are yours to run and improve: where something is manual or unclear, you'll have the real opportunity to make it better. It's a strong fit for someone early in their finance career who takes ownership seriously and wants their work to underpin the teams building tools for multimodal AI.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable, VAT returns and accounts receivable.

 - Process employee expense reports and ensure adherence to company policies.

 - Oversee client invoicing and manage billing workflows.

 - Assist with month-end close procedures, bank reconciliations, and general ledger maintenance.

 - Support financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis.

 - Collaborate on ad-hoc finance and operational projects as they arise.

 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Precision in the core. You take pride in managing the transactional heart of the company. You aren't just processing invoices or reconciling accounts; you view accuracy in bookkeeping and compliance as the critical foundation that allows us to move fast and make informed decisions.

 - A builder of systems. You don’t just accept manual processes as status quo. Whether it’s improving expense workflows or refining billing, you look for the "better way" to do things, ensuring our financial systems scale as quickly as our business.

 - Collaborative by nature. You recognize that effective finance isn’t a back-office function—it’s a partner to the business. You’re ready to bridge the gap between financial operations and the cross-functional teams building the tools for multimodal AI.

 - Ready for high-growth ownership. You are early in your finance career, but you crave responsibility. You want a role where your daily output directly supports our growth, and you’re hungry for the professional development that comes from operating in a fast-paced environment.

 


EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

 - Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

 - 1-2 years of experience in a finance, accounting, or analytical role (tech or startup experience is a plus, but not required).

 - Solid foundational knowledge of bookkeeping, accounts payable/receivable, and invoicing.

 - Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.

 - Proficiency in spreadsheet software and financial tools. An understanding of AI-native finance stacks would be advantageous

 - Proactive mindset with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced, growing environment.

 


WHY ENCORD

 - Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup

 - Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

 - 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

 - Annual learning & development budget

 - Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

 - Company lunches twice a week

 - Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites
